items.quote: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
items.claim: An animal (bullock, sheep, or goat) must be seven days old and under its mother before being accepted as a fire offering to the LORD from the eighth day onward.
items.actor: bullock, or a sheep, or a goat
items.action: brought forth; accepted for an offering made by fire
items.mechanism: seven-day nursing period qualifying animal for acceptance
